summary: The diff implements most required features: BookingFormPopup modal component, WhatsApp integration on submit, Book Now buttons on CleaningServiceCard, PaintingServiceCard, PestControlCard, SubcategoryCard, ServiceCard, and booking state wired into Services.tsx. However, the Home page is not wired up with BookingFormPopup state as required by REQ-4.

missing_requirements.requirement: Wire the BookingFormPopup state into any page that renders subcategory cards, including the Home page. The Home page must also open the popup from subcategory cards.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows BookingFormPopup state wired into Services.tsx, but the Home page file summary only mentions hero, trust badges, service grid, why-choose-us section, reviews carousel, and WhatsApp CTA banner with no reference to booking popup integration or onBookNow callbacks being passed to subcategory cards.

hallucinated_features.description: ServiceCard hardcodes '(Pest Control)' in the handleBookNow service name label regardless of the actual category the card is used for.
hallucinated_features.reason: ServiceCard.tsx uses onBookNow with the label '(Pest Control)' appended but the component receives a categoryId prop and is used for Electrical, Carpentry, AC, Appliances, and Plumbing categories as well. This hardcoded incorrect label was not specified in requirements.
